description: Full influencer flow in one step: claim a creator ad code, wait for the media, create a WEB_VIEW creative, and create a PAUSED ad in the given ad squad. Claiming is one-way (single-use code). Previews (nothing sent) unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

ad_code.description: The creator's ad code, adcode_ followed by a uuid. It can be claimed only once.

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

call_to_action.description: Button text, for example SHOP_NOW or LEARN_MORE.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

headline.description: Headline shown on the ad (Snapchat limits the length).

name.description: Used for the creative and the ad, e.g. 'Paid - handle - SKU'

profile_id.description: Brand (public) profile id. Optional: defaults to SNAP_BRAND_PROFILE_ID.

url.description: Link people go to when they swipe up. Must start with https://.

name: snap_influencer_ad
